result.title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
result.summary: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 KilometerVision，首个基于真实视频、覆盖至 1 公里尺度的地理布局理解基准，并按「地标锚定—路径连接—全局心理地图」三级认知阶段评测 VLM 的空间智能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其诊断结论——VLM 几乎完全依赖 2D 视觉识别与文本匹配来绕过真正的路径积分和几何测量知识——直接关系到视觉证据是否被保留在内部状态并被真正用于空间推理，可作为 LVR 中信息坍缩与视觉旁路的实证线索。
